# Vendored assets

## kenney-input-prompts-1.5.zip

- Source: <https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts> (mirror: <https://kenney-assets.itch.io/input-prompts>)
- Author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
- License: CC0 1.0 — <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/> (no attribution required; credited here anyway)
- Version: Input Prompts 1.5 (v1.5a fixes noted upstream), 1,500 assets, 64×64 grid, PNG spritesheets + SVG vectors + fonts
- SHA-256: `ac2fcf599080b0f3ba2d174c9474db6df1a0e96ff0662580e2da79a122ab78a1`
- Downloaded: 2026-08-27 (no-download link, current at time of capture)
- Coverage: Xbox 360/One/Series, PlayStation 1–5, Steam Deck/Controller/Frame, Valve Index, Switch/Switch 2/Wii/Wii U/GameCube, Meta Quest 1–3, Playdate, keyboard & mouse, touch gestures, generic prompts, flairs

This is the glyph source for the application shell's controller-prompt system (§6.1 of `proposal.md`) and for overlay input hints. It is committed as a zip; builds extract only the referenced subsets into the resource bundle so shipped size tracks actual usage. The `jochona-*` concept art in §18 of the proposal is separate and remains Lunaframe-era brand work pending a Jochona identity pass.
